$comment: Register the vault with Claude Code:
claude mcp add-json personal-twitter-vault "$(cat config/mcp-config.json | jq -c '.mcpServers["personal-twitter-vault"]')"
or copy the mcpServers block into your Claude Code MCP settings.
Replace /Users/adamplace/adam-id with an absolute path if you move the repo.
VAULT_SCOPES omits dms.read on purpose: direct messages contain other people's
words, so grant it only for a session that genuinely needs them.
